# janjez.social

> Kenya's #1 M-Pesa SMM panel. Buy YouTube views, Instagram followers, TikTok likes, WhatsApp channel members, Telegram views, Facebook likes, X (Twitter) followers, Google Maps reviews, Snapchat views, and LinkedIn engagement.

## Services
- YouTube: views, likes, subscribers, watch time, comments, AI-generated comment boost
- Instagram: followers, likes, comments, story views, reels views, save shares
- TikTok: views, likes, followers, shares, comments, live stream views
- WhatsApp: channel members, channel post reactions, channel followers, channel post views
- Telegram: channel members, post views, poll votes, reactions
- Facebook: page likes, post likes, followers, video views, live stream, comments
- X (Twitter): followers, likes, retweets, views, replies
- Google Maps: reviews
- Snapchat: views, followers
- LinkedIn: followers, engagement

## Pricing
- Cheapest: TikTok views from KES 10
- Most orders: 100 to 10,000 units
- Payment: M-Pesa STK push, instant
- Delivery: starts in 60 seconds, most orders under 1 hour
